ticker: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to visit India
Pope Leo XIV diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery
Aramco headquarters struck by Houthi missile attack
IBM to deploy India's first quantum computer
India delays UPI payment fee rollout past Diwali

articles.headline: US Top Diplomat Marco Rubio to Visit India
articles.brief: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to travel to India for high-level discussions focusing on strategic alliances, energy collaborations, and bilateral investment opportunities.

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV Diagnosed With Lung Cancer
articles.brief: The Vatican has confirmed that Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer following a successful surgical procedure to remove the lower lobe of his right lung.

articles.headline: Houthi Missiles Strike Saudi Aramco Headquarters
articles.brief: Aramco's executive headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia suffered a missile strike from Yemen’s Houthi movement, resulting in a localized fire within the complex.

articles.headline: IBM to Deploy India's First Quantum Computer
articles.brief: IBM has announced plans to deploy India's very first quantum computer in Amaravati by early 2027, marking a massive milestone for the nation's technological advancement.

articles.headline: Hyundai Commits $15.5 Billion to India
articles.brief: Hyundai Motor Group has pledged $15.5 billion to transform India into a premier global automotive manufacturing and innovation hub.

articles.headline: India Postpones UPI Payment Fee Rollout
articles.brief: The Indian government has officially delayed the implementation of new UPI payment fees until after the conclusion of the upcoming Diwali festival season.

articles.headline: Nvidia Acquires Stakes in French Tech Startups
articles.brief: Silicon Valley giant Nvidia has expanded its European footprint by acquiring equity stakes in high-profile French technology startups Doctolib and Genesis AI.

articles.headline: India Consider Raising Coal Power Capacity
articles.brief: A senior Indian government official has stated that the country may need to scale up its coal-powered electricity capacity to address surging nationwide energy demands.

articles.headline: Iran Shifts Tactics to Target Gulf Shipping
articles.brief: Intelligence reports reveal Iran has altered military and economic tactics, stepping up attacks on commercial shipping in the Gulf to exert pressure on Washington.

articles.headline: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Planting Spy Device
articles.brief: The FBI has arrested an OpenAI software engineer after a hidden, encrypted recording device was discovered inside an executive conference room in San Francisco.

articles.headline: Fitness Concerns Delay India's New Zealand Squad
articles.brief: Ongoing fitness evaluations for key players like Prasidh Krishna and Harshit Rana have forced selectors to delay finalizing India's squad for the upcoming New Zealand tour.

articles.headline: Shikhar Dhawan to Take Legal Action Over League
articles.brief: Former Indian cricketer Shikhar Dhawan announced plans to pursue legal action against franchise league organizers who allegedly used his name and likeness without permission.

articles.headline: Delhi Police Detain Anti-CEC Protest Leaders
articles.brief: Delhi Police have placed several leaders of the Cockroach Janata Party under preventive arrest following an unauthorized demonstration near the Jantar Mantar area.

articles.headline: Global Oil Prices Climb on Supply Concerns
articles.brief: Crude oil futures extended gains as international traders factored in escalating Saudi supply risks alongside tightening restrictions on Russian diesel flows.

articles.headline: Malawi Motorists Face Severe Fuel Shortages
articles.brief: Motorists across Malawi are enduring long lines and sleeping at petrol stations as a debilitating nationwide fuel shortage makes a sudden return.
